metadata.description:
100 quarters. 25 years.

A milestone like this is rare, and it’s a testament to the people of SPS and the trust of our more than 50,000 customers. 🎉

Every day, our teams come together with passion, curiosity and collective expertise to tackle complex challenges and keep commerce moving forward.

We’re grateful to our customers for partnering with us and letting us help them achieve their goals, and we’re proud of our employees, whose dedication and teamwork make milestones like this possible.

Together, we go further, achieve more and continue powering the connections that move the world of commerce forward.
metadata.name: TeamSPS 100 Quarters of Growth
